parent: Frozen complete f696 allocation plus b472 action/risk/recovery is the only later economic parent; this card fits an information receiver only, no policy or account.
hypothesis: The original39 decision-time Qlib inputs may rank the next-H5 margin by which SOXX beats both cash and SOXL more coherently when trained directly on that joint minimum, rather than combining two independently failed cash and SOXL-relative Ridge heads.
target: min(-cash_advantage_H5,-SOXL_relative_H5) on identical mature Qlib rows. Positive means SOXX beats both alternatives on the original open-to-open price plane; this excludes Tiered costs, drawdown and state feedback.
distinctness: The closed original39 dual-task version trained/used separate cash and SOXL-relative targets and required both heads to pass. This one fixed version changes the receiving economic question to the joint SOXX bridge-asset margin, while reusing their exact feature order and saved two-head held predictions as the stronger matched control. It does not relabel the old models as passed or change historical market identity.

model_and_controls.candidate: One SimpleImputer(median)->StandardScaler->Ridge(alpha=1.0) fit on the saved original39 DatasetH mature training rows and the direct joint target; no hyperparameter search
model_and_controls.saved_two_head_control: On exact same 940 held rows, min(-saved cash_prediction,-saved SOXL_relative_prediction) from the closed dual-task Recorder
model_and_controls.training_mean_control: Constant mean of the new joint training target
model_and_controls.label_and_date_parity: Saved two-head cash/relative held targets and the DatasetH held labels must match exactly before fit; every held forecast evaluated on the same 940 mature rows

stop: Stop before fit on source SHA/NAS, feature order, date/target parity or maturity failures. A failed fixed information gate closes this direct joint receiver; no model family, target min/max, cutoff, year, sign or feature rescue. An information pass only permits a separately frozen exact-f696 own-state0bp Tiered account, then 2/5bp and qualified forward evidence.
scientific_boundary: Reused 2023-2026 held history is development feedback, not independent validation. Gross H5 information MSE is not a native funded SOXX result, and executor output cannot certify promotion.
